title: Hermes Agentplane Worker Lane
summary: Require Hermes worker lanes to treat Agentplane as engineering task truth and Hermes as dispatch/run projection.
content:
## Hermes Agentplane Worker Lane

- Hermes owns dispatch/run lifecycle: queue, assignee, claim, run id, retries, crash detection, comments, dashboard, and human handoff.
- Agentplane owns engineering task lifecycle: task README/frontmatter, plan approval, branch/worktree, verification, PR/integration, finish, and ACR evidence.
- Use `agentplane hermes doctor --json` before lane execution and stop on adapter readiness failures.
- Use `agentplane hermes supervise <task-id> --json` to inspect route state; use `--execute-step` only for one allowlisted route step per Hermes claim.
- Never execute raw shell copied from route text. Classify route output into typed Agentplane commands or block with an unsupported-route reason.
- Write a structured `agentplane hermes lifecycle comment` before every Hermes block or complete transition.
- `agentplane hermes lifecycle complete` is allowed only after Agentplane task status is `DONE`, verification is `ok`, branch_pr integration/finish is complete, and ACR validation passes.
- Treat Hermes board state as projection-only during reconcile; never infer Agentplane `DONE` from Hermes `done`.
